case_order: strength ascending, then seed ascending; all sixteen existing contrasts
cross_size_reproduction: Recompute all existing cross-size matrices and require every overlap entry and assignment score to reproduce within 1e-12.
same_n_rank_control: Within each N, method and common grid, compare the nearest and second-pair subspaces; self-overlaps must be one and off-diagonal overlaps must be zero within 1e-12.
representation_fidelity: For the same N, seed, strength, pair and common grid, compare linear-point and cell-average bases of the identical eigensubspace; record both directions without normalizing the cross-size result.
beta_profile_mismatch: Embed the actual RNG beta arrays from N=400 and N=600 onto each common grid with the corresponding scalar rule; record RMS, mean and maximum absolute differences and Pearson correlation.
